description: The chart illustrates the distribution of experts across different layers, categorized into three groups: G0, G1, and G2. The horizontal axis represents the layer numbers, ranging from 1 to 24 in a linear scale, while the vertical axis represents the number of experts, labeled as "Number of Experts" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10. Each bar is divided into three stacked sections corresponding to G0 (blue), G1 (green), and G2 (yellow), indicating the number of experts in each category for a given layer. The bars show varying heights, with the tallest bar at layer 1 having approximately 9 experts and the shortest bars at layers 7, 11, 12, 14, and 15 having approximately 3 experts. The G2 category (yellow) contributes significantly to the taller bars, particularly in the lower layer numbers, while the G0 (blue) and G1 (green) categories contribute relatively consistent values across the layers. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized. Overall, the chart provides a visual representation of how the number of experts varies across different layers and categories.
